paragraphs: The STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller is a versatile platform for embedded systems development, offering a wide range of peripherals and pins to suit various applications. In this section, we will explore potential future enhancements that can be implemented on top of the current system.
bullets: Implement real-time monitoring features to continuously track soil moisture levels and alert users when the soil moisture drops below a certain threshold. This feature can be achieved by integrating an ADC with interrupts or using a timer to periodically sample the soil moisture sensor.

Develop an advanced alert system that not only triggers audible alerts but also sends notifications via SMS, email, or other communication channels based on predefined thresholds and conditions. This feature can be implemented using a microcontroller's UART interface to send messages over the network.

Add data logging capabilities to record soil moisture levels and other relevant parameters at regular intervals. This feature can be achieved by integrating a timer with an external storage device like an SD card or EEPROM.

Improve the user interface of the system by adding touch controls, buttons, or other interactive elements to allow users to interact with the system more easily. This feature can be implemented using a microcontroller's GPIO pins and interrupts.
